response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves medical treatment for pneumonia, which is an acute illness occurring during the trip. Clause A4.1 covers the costs of hospitalization and treatment for acute illnesses or injuries during the trip. There is no indication that the illness was pre-existing (A5.1), nor that it was related to alcohol, extreme sports, or other general exclusions (A11.1–A11.4)."}
